claim_ceiling: Certifies the bounded repository repair and exact browser-path test design. It does not claim the iPhone is fixed until a fresh post-deployment phone report proves the new evaluation identity and current section evidence.
proven_root_cause: The bootstrap ran a later evaluator but, when no persisted Bug Watch reclassification was needed, accepted an already complete stored/live receipt instead of publishing the just-returned evaluation. Version-only validation also could not distinguish evaluator revisions that shared the same public B-D version.

repair.freshness_binding: Every bootstrap invocation creates an evaluation ID; the bounded receipt and consolidated view must match that exact ID.
repair.quota_path: The just-produced evaluation becomes the live-memory receipt before persistence is attempted, so quota failure cannot revive prior evidence.
